hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Eastern Europe, east of Poland || generally flat with much marshland || landlocked; glacial scouring accounts for the flatness of Belarusian terrain and for its 11,000 lakes || Resources: timber, peat deposits, small quantities of oil and natural gas, granite, dolomitic limestone, marl, chalk, sand, gravel, clay || Exports: fertilizers, rapeseed oil, wood, poultry, beef (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: generally flat with much marshland || Eastern Europe, east of Poland

climate.excerpt: cold winters, cool and moist summers; transitional between continental and maritime || large tracts of marshy land

economy.excerpt: declining Russian energy subsidies will end in 2024; growing public debt; strong currency pressures have led to higher inflation; recent price controls on basic food and drugs; public sector wage increases and fragile private sector threaten household income gains and economic growth || Exports: fertilizers, rapeseed oil, wood, poultry, beef (2023) || Industries: metal-cutting machine tools, tractors, trucks, earthmovers, motorcycles, synthetic fibers, fertilizer, textiles, refrigerators, washing machines and other household appliances
